/--
The notation typeclass for negation.
This enables the notation `-a : α` where `a : α`.
-/
class Neg (α : Type u) where
  /-- `-a` computes the negative or opposite of `a`.
  The meaning of this notation is type-dependent. -/
  neg : α → α
